LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash.label: <color=#FFB25C>Ascendant Flame</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash.descripti: Becomes flame and dashes up to 35 cells along a 3-cell-wide path without requiring line of sight. Enemies take 10 base burn damage, gain 30 Life Burn, are pushed back and stunned for 1 second. Scorch lasts 5 seconds and adds 6 Life Burn each second. Cooldown: 8 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion.label: <color=#FFD37A>Instant Combustion</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion.descriptio: Deals 1 base burn damage separately to each enemy brain and eye within 12 cells, and stuns for 3 seconds. Doubles existing Life Burn and ignites unburning targets. Charge: 3 seconds. Cooldown: 120 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningPillar.label: <color=#FF7A45>Burning Pillar</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningPillar.description: Charges for 3 seconds to place a burning core within 40 cells. The core expands to a 10-cell radius over 3 seconds, then can be moved. Lasts 30 seconds. Each second, enemies take a combined 15 base burn and cut damage and gain Life Burn. Hostile and factionless buildings take 6% of their maximum health as base damage per second. Cooldown: 240 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurn.label: <color=#C95CFF>Time Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurn.description: Charges for 3 seconds, then burns away the target's biological age over 20 seconds to execute it. Mechanoids dissolve into steel and plasteel; buildings return raw materials. Cooldown: 300 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf.label: <color=#FF5C3A>Ashes of Self</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf.description: Adds 20% blood loss and grants 100 Self Burn. Creates a moving 2.4-cell-radius field for 10 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds it burns enemies and adds Life Burn, heals the caster's wounds and scars, and builds Self Burn. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
